This confirms it. The Green_stem_disorder reference shows the same pattern: green stems and retained green leaves while surrounding plants and pods have matured/dried. The test image matches perfectly.

- Pods appear to be maturing normally on the plant
- No leaf lesions, mottling, wilting, or other foliar disease symptoms
- Classic "green stem" presentation at harvest maturity
